_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Rashad Coleman
about_me: I'm Rashad, regional operations director for a Detroit food distributor. I oversee Luis Romero's cold-storage team. I want routing software that knows dock hours and I'm open to piloting startups.
goals: Cut delivery miles 10% with a routing pilot

debriefs.text: Luis Romero, our cold-storage operations manager, is running the Routewise pilot and says early results are good.
Ben Hartley from Routewise wants a case study after the pilot.
Samira Haddad, a transportation planner with Ann Arbor, asked for our delivery patterns on Main Street for the curb pilot.
Ravi Menon, the Ann Arbor angel, used to run a logistics software company and gave me pricing advice.
